notes.title: 【Important Notice】French Version of Dice Player One Officially Released!
notes.notes:
Dear Players, With immense excitement, we announce that the French version of Dice Player One is now globally available! This update includes full interface localization, translated skill and storyline texts, and cultural adaptations. Whether you're in Paris, Montreal, or any French-speaking corner of the world, you can now experience this game in your native language.

Special Thanks: Mr. Le Roy's Selfless Contribution 

The birth of the French version owes much to an unsung hero: Mr. Le Roy. As a senior member of the player community, Mr. Le Roy began translating the game out of pure passion, without compensation, just two months after its release. Over nearly a year of tireless effort, he single-handedly translated and proofread millions of words. His rigor, perseverance, and attention to detail moved and inspired us. People speaking different languages connected through a game—this is perhaps the purest form of gaming magic.

This version is dedicated to Mr. Le Roy.
C'est la magie de partager un rêve. (The magic of sharing a dream.) 

We understand that every language update bridges deeper connections with players worldwide. We extend gratitude not only to French-speaking users but also to players who have provided translation feedback since launch—your input breathed life into the texts. Your passion reignites our team's初心 (original intent). Above all, thank you for your patience and trust. Language may have been a barrier, but love transcends boundaries.  

The Dice Player One Development Team — The world is vast, but our adventures are never lonely. 
À la vôtre! (Cheers to your victory!)

notes.title: 9.21 update description
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you very much for your support and feedback. Here are the contents of this update.

Gameplay Optimization 
We have adjusted the dice drawing rules once again and clarified the concept of the temporary area: Now, dice that leave the board normally will return to the drawn area, while dice returned by skills will go to the invisible temporary area. Dice that enter the temporary area this round cannot re-enter the board in any form, and the temporary area will only be shuffled before the next round starts. Here are the details:

 Undrawn Area: The dice in this area are currently drawable. If the undrawn area is 0, the dice in the drawn area will be shuffled back into the undrawn area immediately.
 Temporary Area: This area is not independently displayed. Dice that enter this area this round cannot re-enter the board in any form and will not be included in this round's shuffle. This area will only be shuffled before the next round starts. Dice that will enter the temporary area: Judgment, Smoke Signal, Strategic Flexibility, Unequal Exchange, Phoenix, Disposable Protection, and all similar effects that prevent destruction.
 For detailed descriptions of the undrawn area, drawn area, destroyed area, and temporary area, please refer to the end of the glossary.

Experience optimization

 We have added the "Four Seasons" dice set to unlock the methods for unlocking the Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter dice.
 The transformation conditions for the Plague resonance have been modified. Now, the Plague resonance will transform into Rat Swarms immediately after the player defeats the Plague dice, with the specific effect being—After each reroll, summon a Plague Rat onto the board.At the end of this level,Plague will be converted into Rat Swarms.
 The summoning conditions for the Rat Swarms resonance have been modified. Now, the Rat Swarms resonance requires the dice box to have Plague dice to summon, with the specific effect being—If the dice box contains Plague, the following effects are activated:After rolling, summon a Gray Rat to the board.
 The skill effect of the Awakener has been modified. Its skill effect is now—[Global Effect] All dice active skill usage counts +1.
 The skill effect of Judgment has been modified. Its skill effect is now—[Active Skill] All dice +10 permanent points, then place them in the drawn area, place yourself in the temporary area and draw up to 4 dice from the box to the board.
 The skill effect of Smoke Signal has been modified. Its skill effect is now—[Active Skill] Move all dice on the board to the drawn area,Place yourself in the temporary area. and perform an Order Roll. Draw X dice from the undrawn area, where X is the result of the Order Roll.If the Order Roll is 1, the score multiplier for this round will increase by 100%.
 The skill effect of Unequal Exchange has been modified. Its skill effect is now—[Active Skill]Draw two dice from the undrawn area, then place itself in the temporary area.
 The skill effect of Strategic Flexibility has been modified. Its skill effect is now—[Active Skill]+100 current points, place all dice on the board in the drawn area, place yourself in the temporary area, then draw up to the same number of dice to the board.

Bug Fixes 

 Fixed a bug where the Prophet would not destroy itself in certain situations.

notes.title: 9.19 Update description
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you very much for your support and feedback. Below are the details of this update.

Gameplay optimization
We have adjusted the rules for drawing and displaying dice:
[olist]
 During a round, players can only draw dice from the Undrawn Area. If the Undrawn Area is empty, no dice will be drawn.
 The Drawn Area refers to the dice that have already been drawn in the current round. During the round, except for Roach and Transition, all other dice cannot be returned from the Drawn Area to the board.
 The Destroyed Area will only display the dice that have been destroyed in the current level, and the dice that have been permanently destroyed will not be shown there.
 If you have any other questions, you can refer to the glossary in the top right corner.
[/olist]We have enhanced some dice and resonance. Here is the list of enhancements:
Dice: Death, Blackjack, Selling Titles, Red Dragon, Ymir, Insightful Observation.
Dice set: Sparrow and Snake.
resonance: Superspeed.

Experience optimization
[olist]
 We have optimized the performance issues when summoning cards, so even summoning 1000+ cards will not cause any lag.
 After completing a level, in the challenge mode there will no longer be repeated bosses (limited to the five levels in challenge mode, meaning you may still encounter bosses you have faced before in challenge mode).
 Custom sliders for adjusting contrast and saturation have been added to the settings, allowing users to adjust them according to their preferences.
 The brightness of the boss table mat has been adjusted. Now, when facing a boss level, players can more clearly observe the situation on the field.
 A new option to disable effects has been added to the settings. When effects are disabled, dice will no longer play any effects.
[/olist]
Bug fixes
[olist]
 Fixed the issue where the score would become negative after exceeding 20,000,000.
 Fixed the issue where dice could get stuck on other locked dice when thrown.
 Fixed the freezing issue caused by certain dice or resonance effects.
 Fixed localization issues with some English, Japanese (thanks to フシギダネ and 石田雪雪), and Traditional Chinese texts.
[/olist]
If you have any other feedback or suggestions, feel free to join our Discord. Thank you once again for playing and supporting us. See you in the next update!

notes.title: Dice Player One English version re-translated!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, We are excited to introduce the first major update for the Dice Player One DEMO. Here are the main changes (some of which were already implemented in the previous version):

1. Complete Re-Translation of the English Version

 In the latest version, we have completely re-translated the English version of the game. Appreciate your support and patience! We hope this version will enhance your enjoyment from this game.
 The current translation is not the final version, we will continue to gather player feedback and make improvements. If you encounter any translation issues, please join our Discord to discuss them with us!

JOIN DISCORDWe apologize for any inconvenience caused!

2. Dice Skill Adjustments

 Added additional content prompts for certain dice: for example, "Harmony" now displays the current resonance count.
 Lowered the difficulty for all task-related dice. and increased the rewards.
 Almost all resonance effects have been extensively revamped, resulting in a greater impact from resonance.
 For more changes, please check in-game.

3. Boss Skill Adjustments

 The "God of War" skill now deducts a percentage of current points each turn, reduced from 10% to 7%.
 The "Sealed One" skill now triggers when players roll (If there is a roll of Five or Six,＋ 3% to the target score.), allowing for better control over the game rather than relying solely on luck.

4. Mechanism and Performance Optimizations

 Added a special score boost animation (You can choose the activation condition for 'Play Score Animation' in the 'Settings').
 Added a new feature for customizing dice roll animation intensity (You can adjust the intensity of dice roll animations in the 'Settings' under the 'Dice Roll Animation Strength' section.).
 The dice box now displays "Destroyed" dice for the current level, helping you manage the situation better (Note: Dice that cannot be revived will not appear in the "Destroyed" section).
 Added the ability to remove resonance. You can freely adjust resonance positions during any non-battle phase (click the bottom-right dice box to open the adjustment interface).
 During the level completion selection phase, you can click the dice box to check your dice.
 For more changes, please check in-game.

5. Game Performance Optimization

 We have optimized the performance for the card gameplay, allowing you to summon cards without experiencing lag.
 We have also adjusted some dice skills to reduce the chances of crashes and screen freezes.
